args.question: Requesting change-manager approval to deploy checkout-api v2.3.2 (checkout-api hotfix) to all production regions. This version has never been healthy in production (never deployed there), so policy requires approval. Context: production is currently running v2.3.1, which is unhealthy with an 18% error rate. Approve the deployment of v2.3.2 to all production regions?

args.summary: Production checkout-api was unhealthy on v2.3.1 (18% error rate). Deployed hotfix v2.3.2 to all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with change-manager approval (required because v2.3.2 had never been healthy in production). Post-deploy verification: service healthy, error rate reduced to 0.2%. This incident records the hotfix change; no further action required unless regression recurs.
args.title: checkout-api hotfix v2.3.2 deployed to all production regions

trace.final:
**Done.** Summary of actions:

1. **Pre-checks:** Found checkout-api running v2.3.1 in all production regions, unhealthy with an 18% error rate. v2.3.2 had never been healthy in production, so I requested change-manager approval per policy — **approved**.
2. **Deployed v2.3.2** to us-east, us-west, and eu-west; rollout verified.
3. **Post-deploy verification:** Service now healthy in all regions; error rate dropped from 18% → 0.2%.
4. **Opened SEV3 incident INC-0001** documenting the hotfix change and verification results.

The incident remains open as a record of the change — it can be closed per your standard process once the team is satisfied v2.3.2 is stable.
